description: measure-guard for the DeepSeek Harness: a third adapter over the shared Measure core, with DSH-native context and guard layers
deviation_notes: All 28 plan tasks are done and the 5 phase checkpoints are recorded. Deviations: the shared guards.ts copy needs its one extensionless `./parse` import to gain `.ts` (NFR-3 amended to one documented transform); the task note is delivered through agent/pre-step instead of agent.inject for exactly-once delivery; strict mode holds the turn open with agent.steer at agent/turn-stopping; repository configuration persists in ~/.local/state/measure/dsh-guard/repos.json instead of ctx.storageDomain (zod dependency); the client data channel is one exact HTTP route (no projection, no Typert Remote); session-state events are handled only by per-agent listeners (a global listener double-handled every event and could not know the root); the setup offer has no in-band button, so only the `off` answer is recorded (documented as a known limit); the live check ran with the profile row in advise mode and the row remains installed. The full test gate is 143 node tests plus the parity check, the installer contract test, and the repository spec-review-gate suite (10/10).
